description.narrative: The project’s main objective is to ensure inclusion and active participation of civil society, including Organizations of Persons with Disabilities’ (OPDs), national and regional institutions and other relevant actors - especially from the Global South - in preparatory meetings, and consultations related to the Global Disability Summit (GDS) 2022. IDA will ensure representation of all regions and all disability constituencies including women with disabilities, youths with disabilities, indigenous persons with disabilities and underrepresented groups of persons with disabilities. By the end of the project, a total of 46 GDS national consultations and 2 regional consultations will have been organized whereby OPDs will discuss priorities and formulate their recommendations to the GDS. Strategic inputs and representation will be ensured through IDA’s role as a co-host in the GDS governing structure set out by the MFA. Mobilization of the disability rights movement across regions, levels and constituencies, including underrepresented groups, will be channeled to inform the GDS and their engagement will pave the way for ownership of the GDS outcomes and its follow-up mechanisms.
